Situation update (last 6 hours)

  • Attack: Qatari LNG tanker reported attacked in the Persian Gulf (TASS).
  • Hostile designations: Iran announces British Royal Navy and RAF as terrorist organizations; Iranian MFA says MI6 will be treated as hostile.
  • Rhetoric / threats: US president said the US “can destroy Iran’s remaining nuclear sites in ten minutes” and also said he is “in no hurry” with Iran.
  • Diplomatic signals: Iran security chief called a US letter a “positive” shift. Media: Iran is weighing the Vance letter amid a renewed Doha peace push.
  • Israel: Nationwide Home Front Command search-and-rescue drills begin today to prepare for simultaneous multi-front emergencies.
  • Military movements / incidents: Israeli forces reported inside the Old City market of Nablus (Shechem).
  • Regional posture: Lebanese president reportedly told Lebanon’s army not to take risks vis‑à‑vis Israel.
  • Gaza / humanitarian: A man killed in a vehicle strike in Tel al‑Hawa named Fouad al'ula. Gaza doctors report extreme overload and trauma.
  • Security enforcement: Israeli authorities to deport 14 foreign activists arrested after clashes near Al‑Lubban / removed foreigners for violating a closed military area.
  • International public reaction: Large protests in France, including burning of US and Israeli flags in Lyon.
  • UN / Yemen: UN demands investigation after a staffer died in Houthi custody.
  • Media reports: Israeli and US leaders reportedly held a secret call; Israeli press speculates on possible dramatic strike deep inside Iran.
  • Threat trend: Escalating regional tension — multiple hostile acts, hardline designations and threatening rhetoric in the past six hours.
  • 🟢 Good News: Iran publicly called a US letter a “positive” shift and is reportedly weighing a Vance/Doha diplomacy push. Israel began nationwide Home Front drills.

Israeli authorities to deport 14 foreign activists after disturbances near an olive‑harvest area; 14 foreign citizens removed for entering a closed military zone (AbuAliExpress / Walla).

  • International incidents / protests: UN demanded an investigation after a staffer died in Houthi custody in Yemen (Al Jazeera). Protests in France included burning US and Israeli flags (Times of Israel / beholdisraelchannel).
  • Threat trend: Rising diplomatic tensions and a reported maritime attack. Insufficient evidence to assess the overall military escalation trend.
  • 🟢 Good News: Iran’s security chief described a US letter as a “positive” shift; reporting that Iran is weighing the Vance letter and a renewed Doha peace push.
